    from collections import Counter as Ct

    nb_r,nb_c=len(R)-1,len(C)-1
    blocks=[[fill]*nb_c for _ in range(nb_r)]
    pts=[]

def rare_colors(grid, frac=0.1):
    """Colors whose count is below frac times the most frequent color's count."""
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    return {c for c, n in cnt.items() if n < frac * max(cnt.values())}

def background(grid):
    """The most frequent color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def marker_lines(grid):
    """Rows and columns containing at least one rare color, as (rows, cols) index lists."""
    rare = rare_colors(grid)
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in rare for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[i][j] in rare for i in range(len(grid)))]
    return rows, cols

def marker_lattice(grid):
    """The matrix of cells at intersections of marker-carrying rows and columns."""
    rows, cols = marker_lines(grid)
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]

def marked_blocks(grid):
    """Blocks of the marker lattice whose four corners share one rare color, colored by it on the background; None where uncolored."""
    L = marker_lattice(grid)
    fill = background(grid)
    nr, nc = len(L) - 1, len(L[0]) - 1
    blocks = [[None] * nc for _ in range(nr)]
    for r in range(nr):
        for c in range(nc):
            cs = {L[r][c], L[r][c + 1], L[r + 1][c], L[r + 1][c + 1]}
            if len(cs) == 1:
                v = next(iter(cs))
                if v in rare_colors(grid):

    return blocks, fill
